remarks: Rare opportunity. Experience the quintessential charm of coastal Connecticut in this exceptional unique residence which seamlessly blends historic character with modern convenience, perfectly situated in one of Westport's most desirable locations. Full of soul and architectural detail, this antique home retains its original 19th-century character with stunning wood floors and exposed wood beams. The interior is bathed in natural light and features a versatile layout, including an inviting living room/den and a dining room for entertaining. The eat-in kitchen is bright with newer appliances.  There is a generously sized bedroom with ample closet space & an in-unit laundry room with additional storage space for your convenience. Enjoy your own private yard space, perfect for morning coffee or outdoor relaxation, plus plenty of on-site parking. Rare and worry-free, the monthly rent includes heat, hot water, cooking gas, electricity, trash removal, and ground maintenance. Leave the car behind! You are steps away from the Westport Library, the Levitt Pavilion, fine dining, and premier shopping. The Westport Farmers' Market and the train commuter shuttle are nearby. Many more amenities like the Long Shore Golf Club and the many beaches of Westport are within a short drive or bike ride. Schedule your tour today!
